what: Over a white curtain, the first line of text is revealed from the left and cleared (1.2s), and the second line follows (.9s, starting at 1.1s). Meanwhile the outline of the letter-shaped hole in the curtain (the page below shows through) is drawn with 1s power2.inOut, the tail text attaches next to the hole to form one word, and the white half-circle covering the hole is swept away at .9s. Then the curtain, hole and all, rotates 20° and grows 10× over 1.5s power3.in while the tail text flies off 20× around its upper-left axis, and the page opens (fx:play .4s later, fx:done at the end). Once a day only

options.hold: When the second line starts (sec), default 1.1
options.draw: Time to draw the hole outline (sec), default 1
options.scale: Scale at which the curtain grows, default 10 (tail text is doubled)
options.play-at: Time (sec) to send fx:play after zoom starts, default .4
options.once: If ‹day›, it plays only once a day — on return it goes straight to fx:play with no curtain {quick: true}
options.name: once record name (to keep it separate per page)
options.[data-fx-part=sheet]: Perforated membrane SVG (evenodd path) — fill is --kf-surface
options.[data-fx-part=wedge]: White half-circle that covers the hole, then sweeps away (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=tail]: Trailing text left next to the hole (optional)
